Summary: R0 Foundation & Platform
Description: Monorepo, Fastify skeleton, auth for four consumer classes, migration tooling, production schema baseline and characterization fixtures. Blocks all booking work.

Summary: R1 Booking Data & API
Description: Relational booking aggregate with real foreign keys, data migration from the current store, availability view, the server-side guard gauntlet and the write API.

Summary: R2 Booking Frontend
Description: React SPA screens replacing the booking view of allotment_v2.html: calendar, manifest, form, action modals, seat locks.

Summary: R3 Strangle & Cutover
Description: The bridge that keeps fleet, boat ops and vans working while booking is served by the new API, then the cutover and rollback runbook.

Summary: P0-00 Restore the monolith build (os-backend + db/migrations)
Description: server.js:34-35 requires ./os-backend/src/mapping/os_repo.js, deleted at 094dde1. The require is top-level so it fires in blob mode too. Fix: git checkout HEAD~1 -- os-backend db/migrations. The strangler needs a running monolith. Same as S1-01 in MODERNIZATION_BACKLOG.md.

Summary: P0-01 Capture the production schema as the real baseline
Description: db/migrations was deleted and repo copies have drifted from production in BOTH directions (confirmed on v_seat_availability). Dump full DDL of operation_schemas read-only from prod; build every view from pg_get_viewdef, never from a repo .sql file. Emit db/baseline/schema_<date>.sql, inventory.json and REPORT.md listing which tables have a PK, which have any FK, and which have neither.

Summary: P0-02 Monorepo scaffold (pnpm workspace)
Description: apps/api (Fastify + TS), apps/ops-web (Vite + React + TS), packages/contracts (zod + OpenAPI), packages/db, packages/pricing stub. strict TS, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest. pnpm dev runs api:3001 and web:5173. CI runs typecheck + lint + test.

Summary: P0-03 Fastify skeleton and cross-cutting concerns
Description: Env config validated by zod at boot. pino logging with request id. One error envelope {error:{code,message,details,requestId}}. Request/response validation from packages/contracts. OpenAPI 3.1 at /docs. healthz and readyz. CORS allow-list, one origin per consumer class.

Summary: P0-04 AuthN/AuthZ for four consumer classes
Description: Staff JWT with area permissions (operations, accounting, sales, fleet); B2C service token (availability read + booking create only); ERP service token (booking/pricing read, ledger write); agent token row-scoped to its own agent_id. Row scoping enforced in the query layer, not post-fetch. Agent A requesting agent B gets 404 not 403.

Summary: P0-05 Migration tooling and CI database
Description: Forward-only checksummed migration runner in packages/db. migrate up|status|new. No auto-down in production. CI spins throwaway Postgres, applies db/baseline then all migrations, runs tests. A tampered checksum fails the run.

Summary: P0-06 Characterization fixtures from production
Description: The oracle for every Phase 1 parity test. Anonymized prod slice covering: multi-trip, charter, OVN pair, seat-locked (parent/sub/month), all 8 statuses, over-capacity pending (holds no seats) vs discount pending (holds seats), partial-cancelled, rescheduled, weather-resolved, B2C-owned with b2cOverride, legacy schemaVer!=2, and one with ops boat+van assigned. Coverage script fails if a status is unrepresented.

Summary: P0-07 ADR: the strangler bridge for booking
Description: Evaluate (a) API source of truth with read-through adapter, (b) dual-write with reconciliation, (c) monolith booking view disabled. Recommended (c)+(a); reject (b) because a blob store and a relational store with no shared transaction will diverge. Specify the adapter contract and its deletion criteria.

Summary: RT-01 Rate types read-only API (pulled forward)
Description: Minimum slice of the sales domain needed to unblock booking pricing. Tables for rate_type, seat rates (route x zone x pax type), route validity, route bundles, charter rates, add-ons. Normalize the per-route longtail shape at migration time so the old flat shape never reaches the new schema. GET /v1/rate-types and /:id.

Summary: BK-01 Relational model for the booking aggregate
Description: Source of truth: docs/booking.model.ts and workflows/01 section 4. NOT docs/BOOKING.md (stale). Tables: booking, booking_trip, booking_trip_pax (replaces the 12-key pax object), booking_passenger, booking_addon, booking_adjustment, booking_fee_item, booking_price_breakdown, booking_ops keyed by service_date (replaces the day-1 bk.ops / day-2+ trip.ops split), booking_history, cancellation, partial_cancel, reschedule, approval, foc_approval, weather_resolve, alt_pickup, attachment. FKs to agent, rate_type, route, boat, vehicle, pickup_area. Deliver ERD + migration + MAPPING.md covering 100% of fields.

Summary: BK-02 Seat lock model with derived usage
Description: seat_lock (with parent_id self-FK), seat_lock_usage keyed (lock_id, trip_date), booking_trip_lock_draw as the SINGLE source of truth. The used counter becomes a derived VIEW, not a stored column - this deletes bkV2LockAudit, LockCoverage, LockFixUsed and LockFixTree. Do not port them. Child locks contribute 0 to the pool. Month/bulk locks use rolling per-trip release, never a global expiry.

Summary: BK-03 Availability as a view plus service
Description: Port getAllotment: available_capacity - seats_consumed - locked_seats. Exclude cancelled/cancelled_weather/rejected everywhere; exclude charter trips from seat consumption; subtract check-in losses; honour bkPendHoldsSeat (over-capacity pendings hold NO seats, every other pending reason does). Hazard: a v_seat_availability view exists in prod and has drifted both ways - build from pg_get_viewdef then supersede with a new named view. Parity: byte-identical numbers to the monolith for every fixture (route,date).

Summary: BK-04 Data migration: existing store to new booking schema
Description: Backfill BK-01/BK-02 tables from production. schemaVer 2 migrates fully; legacy v1 migrates with a legacy flag and stays read-only. Normalize the dual pax shape. Collapse bk.ops + trip.ops into booking_ops by service date. Empty arrays become zero child rows. Emit MIGRATION_REPORT.md: row counts in=out, SUM(total) to the satang, counts by status, and every failed booking with a reason. Failing loudly beats silently dropping. Idempotent, rehearsed on a prod clone.

Summary: BK-05 Booking read API
Description: GET /v1/bookings (date range, route, agent, status, channel; paginated), /v1/bookings/:id, /v1/manifest?date=&routeId= returning everything the by-trip-date ops view renders in ONE round trip, /v1/availability, /v1/seat-locks. Agent row-scoping from P0-04. Assert no N+1 on the busiest fixture date.

Summary: BK-06 Port the guard gauntlet server-side
Description: THE task that makes a multi-consumer API safe. Every guard from bkV2CommitBooking becomes API-side validation in one transaction: required fields, B2C exemptions (guide-language and route-closed degrade to soft incomplete flags), contract programme whitelist, duplicate detection, and the anti-overbook tiering - lockViolation HARD BLOCK with no override, licenseBlock HARD BLOCK, over-cap-within-licence to pending_approval, discount>0 on a confirmed save to pending_approval. On edit only a genuine increase is guarded and the booking excludes its own seats. Concurrency: SELECT FOR UPDATE or serializable with retry; N parallel creates against N-1 free seats must yield exactly N-1 successes, run 100x. No guard may live only in the frontend.

Summary: BK-07 Booking write API
Description: POST /v1/bookings, PATCH /:id (named fields only), and cancel, restore, partial-cancel, reschedule, approve, reject, foc-approve, foc-reject. Every mutation writes booking_history in the same transaction. Optimistic concurrency via a row version column replacing the global app_state.version. THE point of the rewrite: PATCH of one field must not touch ops, upgrades, fee_items, reschedule, partial_cancels, cancellation, history, invoice_id or payment_status - write the test. Cancel returns lock draws and voids the invoice in the same transaction; a failed void ROLLS BACK the cancellation (today it only console.warns).

Summary: BK-08 Lock draw and return as transactional operations
Description: Draw on create; return-then-redraw on edit; return on cancel; redraw on restore with an explicit shortfall report. Holder priority agent then office then global when no explicit pick. The "edit ten times, counted as used ten times" regression must be structurally impossible. Property test over random operation sequences.

Summary: BK-09 Pricing service
Description: packages/pricing as pure functions with no DB access. Port bkV2TripSubtotal (seat fr/th + bundle, or charter starter + extra-per-pax), bkV2AddOnInfo, bkV2CalcQuote, promo overlay resolution, FOC discount as forgone revenue stored negative, OVN return legs at 0 with the charge on the outbound. The write path freezes the result into booking_price_breakdown. Every fixture must match to the satang; investigate mismatches rather than tolerating them.

Summary: BK-10 Fix the documented bugs - do not port them
Description: Six known defects that must not be reproduced, each with a test named after the finding: (1) weather reschedule must clear ops boat/van/check-in; (2) partial cancel must return lock draws and adjust the invoice; (3) no toISOString().slice(0,10) - store DATE and resolve today in Asia/Bangkok; (4) status labels for pending_approval and cancelled_weather; (5) calendar zone from the trip, not the dead v1 bk.pickup field; (6) voiding an invoice must reverse its payment rows.

Summary: BK-11 React booking read screens
Description: Calendar month grid, routes-x-days matrix, by-trip-date manifest, all-bookings table, booking detail. TanStack Query against BK-05. No global mutable store, no innerHTML. Carry over the UI lessons: sticky-header offsets computed not hardcoded, no full-subtree re-render while an input has focus, keep backdrop-filter off cards containing dropdowns.

Summary: BK-12 React booking form (create and edit)
Description: Per-field PATCH. Validation is SERVER-DRIVEN: BK-06 returns structured errors and the form renders them. Do not duplicate a single guard rule in the client - client checks are affordance only (disabled buttons, hints) and never enforcement. Removing a client hint must not change what the API accepts. Editing a booking with boat+van assigned must leave the assignment intact.

Summary: BK-13 React action modals
Description: Cancel (reason catalogue + charge mode), restore, partial cancel (per-pax-type reduce with charged/waived split), reschedule (fee mode + collection), approve/reject with the seats-after-approval impact preview, FOC approve/reject. Each maps 1:1 to a BK-07 endpoint.

Summary: BK-14 React seat locks screen
Description: List, create day/bulk/month, sub-group create, release, add seats, per-agent KPI, and the draw-source picker used inside the booking form. No stale used count is possible because there is no stored counter.

Summary: BK-15 Strangler bridge for booking
Description: The riskiest integration. Fleet, boat ops and vans stay in the monolith and read bk.ops. Per the P0-07 ADR: disable the monolith booking view and link out; implement the read-through adapter so boat assignment, van assignment, van groups, pickup times and check-in keep working against API-owned bookings; route the monolith writes through PATCH /v1/bookings/:id/ops. Acceptance: a full operational day works end to end in the monolith - assign boat, assign van, van group, job order, pier check-in - rehearsed on a prod clone.

Summary: BK-16 Cutover and rollback runbook
Description: Freeze window, final BK-04 migration run, reconciliation (counts + money), route switch, smoke tests, and rollback to the monolith inside 15 minutes including how to replay writes taken by the new system. Full timed dry run on a prod clone; rollback rehearsed at least once.
